title: Bawd and butcher
html_source: This is clearly a reference back to the Aeolus chapter where Stephen expressed, “We walk through ourselves, meeting robbers, ghosts, giants, old men, young men, wives, widows, brothers-in-love, but always meeting ourselves,” and that the “lord of things as they are… is doubtless all in all in all of us, ostler and butcher, and would be bawd and cuckold too…” Stephen despises the bawd and butcher with which he stuns himself too in the blow, and of which he would rid himself, but “Not yet awhile. A look around.”

anchor.prefix: Your heart you sing of. I between them. Where? Between two roaring worlds where they swirl, I. Shatter them, one and both. But stun myself too in the blow. Shatter me you who can.
anchor.suffix:
were the words. I say! Not yet awhile. A look around. 

 Yes, quite true. Very large and wonderful and keeps famous time. You say right, sir. A Monday morning, 'twas so, indeed.
